caption: Using dominoes 1, 2, 3 joins top a·ab·bab and bottom aab·b·ab. After the third domino both joins are aabbab, length 6, so 1,2,3 is a match and also an MPCP solution because it starts with domino 1.

spec.title: Using dominoes 1, 2, 3
spec.aria: A left-to-right flow showing that after using domino 1 the top is a and bottom aab, after domino 2 the top is aab and bottom aabb, and after domino 3 both are aabbab, so the final node marks a match and an MPCP solution because it starts with domino 1.
